events.text:
### Priority list
1. `#main` (h1 "Shop" + 4 `.product-card` entries) — this is effectively the entire rendered page (397,449px² area, spans full viewport width/height), so getting the heading text and card order/content exactly right is the top priority.
2. The `.product-card` fragments and their nested `.badge` span — red-twine confirms these repeat (4x cards, 2x badges) but with a structural variant (2 cards have a "Featured" badge, 2 don't); preserving that optional-badge distinction rather than flattening all cards to one shape is the main componentization risk.

Windtailor confirms there's no author CSS on this page at all — every computed style is just UA default (body `margin: 8px`, h1 `font-size:32px; font-weight:700`, everything else plain `display:block` with no color/spacing/radius tokens). The `product-card` and `badge` classes carry zero actual styling despite sounding like they should. So the clone should not invent card/badge visual treatment — that would be fabrication, not fidelity.

events.text: Fidelity check passed on round 2 with an exact match (odiff reported 0 changed pixels, exit code 0). Summary: **Componentization decisions** - Confirmed via red-twine that `.product-card` (4 occurrences) and `.badge` (2 occurrences) are genuine repeating fragments, so I kept them as literal repeated markup with the badge present only on cards 2 and 4 — not flattened into one shape, since the two variants genuinely differ in structure. - crow-nester's priority list flagged `#main` (h1 + 4 cards) as effectively the whole page, so all fidelity effort went there; there was no secondary section worth separate attention on this page. **Special handling** - windtailor on `body` revealed the source page has **zero author CSS** — every computed value (serif UA font, `h1{font-size:32px;font-weight:700}`, `body{margin:8px}`, inline ``) is a plain browser default, despite class names like `product-card`/`badge` sounding like they should carry styling. I deliberately did not invent card/badge visual treatment for this reason. - Round 1 (Tailwind CDN with default config) scored 1.19% diff: Tailwind's Preflight reset silently overrode UA defaults — switching the font to sans-serif, forcing `` to `display:block` (which knocked the "Featured" badge onto its own line instead of staying inline before the image), and altering paragraph spacing. Fixed by setting `corePlugins: { preflight: false }` since there's no real design system here to justify a reset. - Image `src` values are relative paths (`/product-1.jpg`, etc.) with no live site to hotlink against — this is a local fixture, so I preserved them verbatim rather than fabricating URLs; they render as broken images in both original and clone identically. **Unrecreatable**: nothing — no canvas/video/iframe on this page. Screenshots for all rounds are in `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-gh7Ijq/` (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`, `diff-round1.png`, `clone-round2.png`). Final clone written to the requested path: `.../gumshoe-agent-run-gh7Ijq/clone.html`.
